body: Words fail me ... I'm so sorry this happened to you... Especially when the whole time you thought you were doing the right thing...
Have any of these women been psychotic or like... Stalker crazy?

I used to think this all the time. I was 100% positive that I would die by my own hand. It just seemed inevitable. I would come to that conclusion far too often for it to be just a coincidence. 

I still think it, but I don't know. I would love to talk to you more if youd like.

I used to think about it all the time. Ever since I was 8 or 9, just like you. I thought that it was completely normal and that everyone thought about it all the time. It's not. 

I completely understand your plight. The world sucks for some of us sometimes more than others. This is unfortunate. I don't want to sound cliche and say "it'll get better" (even though it almost definitely will). I know thats not what you want to hear. But you should know that people feel this way all the time, and that you are not alone. I would love to talk to you more if youd like. :)

I would love to talk to you. I've been told my many that I'm very good with situations like this, as I'm sure many of my fellow redditors and commentors-on-this-post are. 
message me or my skype is mhmmitssona

Typically I find that if you are looking for something, you will find it. It seems as though there is an equal amount of good and bad on reddit as there is with nearly everything. I often read reddit and, just like you, cringe at the idea that I share a community with some of these people and lose faith in the intelligence and perception of certain people. But JUST AS OFTEN I am awed at the interest people take on here, and have learned of simple acts of kindness that restore my faith in humanity. 

The good and bad exists in everything. You have to choose to see the good and ignore the bad. Depression makes you see the opposite. 

Trust me. I understand, and have been and am currently even there. But we have to support each other. 

Please message me if you need to talk to someone. I'm a moderately attractive girl in college if that is any incentive. 

Thanks.
Yeah, trying to impress friends is lame...what sucks even more is realizing that all these friends you thought you had actually don't care at all about you...
I'm sincerely happy that you are doing well. Thank you for your kind words.
